thread:
Marta (Growth): Quick runthrough: were Go for the benchmark + webinar launch next Tue. Need final SEO tasks locked today: keyword targets, JSON-LD (Event+FAQ), internal linking anchors for all launch posts, and a redirects + canonical mapping for the gated report. EOD?
Eli (SEO): Ill take keywords + schema. Proposing primary keyword "inference benchmark 2026" + "LLM inference cost benchmark" and 5 supporting longtails. Will drop a mini-sheet.
Rina (Content): Internal linking plan: add a single contextual link in each launch post to /benchmark-summary and vary anchors ("benchmark findings", "benchmark summary", "benchmark results"). Add hero CTA on docs to the webinar register.
Carlos (Infra): For stability I prefer gated file under /downloads/benchmark-2026.pdf. Will add 301s + X-Robots-Tag: noindex,follow. Need exact slug confirmed.
Marta (Growth): Use /downloads/benchmark-2026.pdf — confirmed. Also redirect /benchmark -> /benchmark-summary (301) and make sure trailing slash normalized.
Eli (SEO): Minimal FAQ JSON-LD for summary page (drop into <head>):
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What does the benchmark cover?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Latency, throughput, and cost across models and configs."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Who should read the report?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Engineers, infra and product teams evaluating tradeoffs for model serving."}}]}
```
Eli (SEO): Event JSON-LD stub for webinar (replace ISO):
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Benchmark Findings","startDate":"2026-07-07T17:00:00Z","description":"Live walkthrough of benchmark takeaways and Q&A for engineering teams.","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example.com/webinar/register"}}
```
Carlos (Infra): Redirect rules for PR (nginx-style):
```
# benchmark redirects
rewrite ^/benchmark$ /benchmark-summary permanent;
rewrite ^/benchmark/pdf$ /downloads/benchmark-2026.pdf permanent;
rewrite ^/webinar$ /webinar/register?utm=launch permanent;
```
Carlos (Infra): Smoke/Curl tests to include in deploy notes: 
```
# expect 301 -> summary
curl -sI https://redwood.example.com/benchmark | grep -i Location
# check X-Robots-Tag header on download after auth proxy applied
curl -sI https://redwood.example.com/downloads/benchmark-2026.pdf | grep -i X-Robots-Tag
```
Rina (Content): Canonical rules: summary page -> self-canonical to /benchmark-summary; gated pdf -> noindex, follow and set X-Robots-Tag. For launch series keep rel=prev/next; if duplication is an issue canonicalize to page 1. Also OG/Twitter meta should point to summary for social shares.
WebAuditBot: crawl: flagged 6 near-duplicate meta descriptions in /blog/launch-posts. Recommend unique 120-155 char metas. Scheduled re-check at 09:00 UTC tomorrow.
Marta (Growth): Deliverables for EOD: Eli -> keyword mini-sheet + JSON-LD snippets; Carlos -> redirects CSV (source,target,status,notes) + curl tests; Rina -> list of updated posts + anchor texts and updated meta suggestions. I'll finalize registration CTA and email subject.
Eli (SEO): One more: watch query-string variants for campaign params. Ensure redirect mapping preserves utm when useful or canonicalizes otherwise.
Carlos (Infra): Will add tests for /benchmark/ (trailing slash) and /benchmark?utm=* behavior. I'll run linkcheck after deploy and post results.
Marta (Growth): Great. Drop artifacts in the shared drive and Ill sign off. Thanks team :rocket:
